info.longBusinessSummary: Opera Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides mobile and PC web browsers and related products and services in Ireland, Singapore, the United States, and internationally. The company offers specialized browsers, including Opera One browser, Opera AI, Opera GX; Opera Neon, a subscription-based agentic AI browser designed for productivity-oriented users; and offers Web3 and e-commerce services. It also operates Opera Ads, an online advertising platform; GameMaker, a 2D gaming development platform; and Opera News, an AI-powered personalized news discovery and aggregation service. Opera Limited was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Oslo, Norway. Opera Limited is a subsidiary of Kunlun Tech Co., Ltd.

news.title: Opera reaches 100 million PC users for the first time, growing 16% year over year
news.summary: Opera (NASDAQ: OPRA) today announced that its PC browsers reached 100 million monthly active users in October 2026 – the first time the company has crossed this milestone. The figure represents 16% growth year over year, or 14 million more monthly users in 12 months. PC users now make up more than a third of the nearly 290 million people who use Opera's browsers on desktop and mobile every month, and are central to Opera's push to strengthen its presence in Western markets.

rationale.growth: Years 1–2 from analyst consensus (7 analysts: 20.3%, 14.7%); then a straight-line fade to 2.5% terminal growth by year 7.
rationale.ebit_margin: Starts at last year's EBIT margin (20.5%) and moves to the 4-year median (20.5%) over 5 years.
rationale.tax: Median effective tax rate (15.7%), kept within 15–30%.
rationale.reinvestment: Historical medians: D&A 3.3%, capex 2.7% of revenue; working capital 5.5% of revenue, so each extra $1 of sales ties up $0.05. Stock-based compensation (3.3% of revenue) stays inside GAAP EBIT and is not added back, so it is treated as a real cost. IFRS reporters: lease payments sit in financing cash flow, so check capex covers them.
rationale.wacc: CAPM: risk-free 4.91% (US 10-year Treasury yield (CBOE ^TNX via Yahoo Finance)) + adjusted beta 1.19 × ERP 5.0% + small-cap premium 1.0% = cost of equity 11.88%. Pre-tax cost of debt 6.58% (interest ÷ debt). Market-value weights: debt 0.7%.
rationale.exit_multiple: Median peer EV/EBITDA (8.9x) as a cross-check terminal value.
